settings.title: Warms milk and water, anywhere
settings.text: Heat a bottle of milk or water at the park, in the car or mid-flight. No kettle, hob or microwave needed.

settings.title: Heats fast, with a long battery life
settings.text: Quick heating means a hungry baby isn’t left waiting, and a long-lasting rechargeable battery keeps it ready for days out and long journeys.

settings.title: Large capacity, clear display
settings.text: Plenty of room for a feed, and the digital temperature display lets you check it’s just right before you give the bottle.

settings.title: Iceless 360° cooling
settings.text: Keeps breast milk cold for up to 24 hours without needing any ice, so it’s ready whenever you are.

settings.title: 650ml capacity, fits two 300ml bottles
settings.text: Room for two full 300ml bottles, so you can carry a whole day’s feeds in one bottle.

settings.title: Leak-proof lid, 2 cooling cylinders included
settings.text: A leak-proof lid keeps your bag dry, and the two cooling cylinders included can be used together to keep milk cold all day.
